watches.name: Royale Paris Chrono Watch - 39,5 mm
watches.description: With the Royale Paris Chrono BPM, Pequignet Manufacture brings together two legacies on a single dial: the measurement of performance through the chronograph, and the French Touch that emerged in Parisian clubs in the late 1990s. The tachymetric scale of the Royale Paris Chrono gives way to a BPM (Beats Per Minute) graduation, transforming a sporting measuring instrument into a musical compass. The dial draws on colour codes familiar to an entire generation: an electric blue gradient, from azure evenings to the pitch-black nights of minimalist clubs for the night owls. The sound bars, symbolically displayed between midnight and 2 a.m., are a nod to the importance of maintaining a perfectly balanced, unsaturated sound, something every true music lover will respect before launching the next track. Like a pulsometer, with the pusher activated and 30 bass-drum beats counted, the scale indicates where you are: between 110 and 130 BPM, welcome to the world of French Touch. At 60 BPM, the day has been intense: it is time for reggae. From 70 to 95 BPM, you are on Planet Rap or perhaps somewhere in a “ Je t’aime… moi non plus ” kind of universe. Above 140 BPM, eyes closed and arms in the air, trance takes over. Like the rest of the Royale Paris collection, this version is equipped with interchangeable straps. This fifth movement has been designed to create a chronograph watch whose thickness remains well controlled. Like the Maison’s other four movements, all components are sourced within a radius of less than 80 km around the Manufacture.

Used since Antiquity in jewellery and decorative arts, it is distinguished by the depth and uniformity of its colour. The intense blackness and unique texture of this natural stone enhance the rose gold-plated 5N indexes and hands, adding a touch of warmth while ensuring perfect legibility. A MANUFACTURE MOVEMENT: THE CALIBRE INITIAL® The Attitude Onyx is powered by the Calibre Initial®, featuring bidirectional winding and offering a 65-hour power reserve. This movement is entirely designed, developed and assembled in Morteau, in our workshops. Pequignet sources as locally as possible: all components for its five Manufacture movements are sourced within 80 kilometres of Morteau, while the Calibre Initial® comprises 72% French-origin components.

watches.name: Attitude Globe Sauter : The cap of Good Hope watch - Limited edition
watches.description: On the occasion of the opening of the exhibition “Globe Sauter × Pequignet” at the Pequignet boutique in Paris, the two manufactures present a limited series of watches and terrestrial globes, the result of a collaborative effort between a geographer, a watchmaker, a painter, and an artisan. Globe Sauter & Cie is the last remaining manufacturer of terrestrial globes in France. Each globe is handcrafted and hand-painted in Besançon, in keeping with an ancestral savoir-faire inherited from the 16th-century tradition. Each dial is a map of a corner of the world, its outlines printed in carbon black on 100% cotton paper from Zuber-Rieder paper mill (Boussières, 10 km from Besançon), then hand-painted in watercolour. The Cape of Good Hope: a mythical passage point since the Age of Discovery, the Cape of Good Hope marks the moment when navigators prepare to leave the Atlantic Ocean to reach Asia. Its evocative name carries a powerful resonance in the collective imagination. Instead of hours, the markers indicate degrees of longitude: 90° (east) at 3 o’clock 180° (south) at 6 o’clock 270° (west) at 9 o’clock a compass arrow, echoing the Manufacture Pequignet’s signature orange, at 12 o’clock – a reminder that the watch can be used as a compass. This limited series consists in 24 unique pieces, all drawn and hand-painted by Alain Sauter. The Attitude watch is operated by Calibre Initial®, the third movement designed by the Manufacture Pequignet. It has a patented instant date jump and winding system. Much work has been done on the finish, such as its superb perforated oscillating weight visible in relief on the back of the watch. This exclusive calibre combines technicality, accuracy and reliability. Its advantages: its Calibre Initial® designed and manufactured in France and its 65 hour power reserve (weekend "proofed").

watches.name: Royale Paris Watch - 39,5 mm
watches.description: This Royale Paris 39.5mm power reserve and small seconds model features a soft coral-hued dial. This unique shade adds a touch of refinement and elevates the watch's timeless aesthetic. This version with its smaller diameter has a case and dial with sophisticated finishes that provide a worthy setting for the Calibre Royal® movement powering this model. The applied lugs, a strong signature of this collection, have been refined and feature a brushed finish on top and a polished finish on the sides. The sculpted case profile has a concave "gouge" shaped recess, which is repeated all around the dial. Its flanks have been delicately hollowed out to slim its silhouette and give it a geometry that combines strength and style. The slightly domed and anti-reflective "glass box" sapphire crystal also fully contributes to the watch's elegance. With its 318 components, the Calibre Royal® movement that powers the Royale Paris is the first French-made mechanism to place its horological complications on the same mainplate. It is protected by 8 international patents. It has a single large barrel that offers an improved power reserve. It now reaches 96 hours on this model, compared to 88 hours previously. This automatic movement is equipped with a unique bidirectional winding system by the oscillating weight and a large, high-inertia diamond-cut balance wheel. Its double large instantaneous jump date and day window on the same axis allows for adjustments at any time. The Calibre Royal® is designed and developed in-house. It is hand-assembled in the Morteau workshops. All of its components are sourced from within 80km of the Manufacture. Like the three other in-house movements, the Calibre Royal® undergoes rigorous adjustments to achieve chronometric precision, with the daily rate ranging between -4 and +6 seconds. This exceptional accuracy guarantees an average of between +2 or -2 seconds per day, thus meeting the most demanding criteria for chronometry.

watches.name: Royale Tourbillon watch - Limited edition
watches.description: Pequignet unveils, at a preview showing during Watches and Wonders 2024, its first flying tourbillon, a true extraordinary horological feat. Designed for enthusiasts of French high watchmaking, it will be manufactured in a limited series of 24 pieces. This model is equipped with the fourth Pequignet «in-house» movement: based on the prestigious Calibre Royal®’s construction, the name Calibre Royal® Tourbillon logically appeared. The flying tourbillon is a complex regulating mechanism. Traditionally placed at 6 o’clock, the flying tourbillon is special as it is mounted without any upper bridge, giving the impression of wearing a weightless tourbillon cage on the wrist, visually unobstructed. A nearly hypnotic wonder to observe. For this horological marvel, this 1-minute tourbillon (rotating in sixty seconds) features a concentric balance wheel in the cage. The cage itself is made of titanium, a particularly delicate metal to machine, especially for such a small component. This exceptional «made in France» Royale Tourbillon watch is mounted on a sumptuous blue alligator strap that complements its dial. It is combined with a tongue buckle made of the same metal as the case. For a rare watch, a specific box: made of lacquered wood and specially designed for this first Pequignet Tourbillon, echoing the midnight blue and wave shape of the dial.

The top-stitched leather recalls the bridle traces on horses harnessed to vehicles and the hooks are inspired by the stirrups on the saddle of mounted horses. Combining strength and elegance, in keeping with "Mankind's noblest conquest", this collection has been designed for ladies, who wish to possess a discreet, elegant watch, but one with undeniable personality.
